item.title: Advanced English Vocabulary: What Is a “Sycophant”? | 15 New Words
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-trimmed version. An LLM deleted boilerplate sentences from the original article and left the rest verbatim. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: one short sentence

admirer and a sycophant? Learn 15 English words and expressions for flattery in this vocabulary class, from friendly ones like butter someone up and sweet talker to insulting ones like bootlicker, brown-nose, and yes-man. It’s fine to give compliments once in a while. But there is a difference between honest praise and flattery that people see as ass kissing. In this lesson, I’ll teach you words to describe people who say nice things in a smart or sincere way, and words for people who flatter too much to get something they want. Don’t be the second kind!
